description.zh: 常用的官方 MCP 服务器：fetch（抓取网页转 Markdown，需要 uv/uvx）、memory（知识图谱记忆）、sequential-thinking（分步思考）。需要本机有 Node.js（npx）和 uv。启用后全体员工可用，可在下方逐个开关。
description.en: Popular official MCP servers: fetch (web page to Markdown, needs uv/uvx), memory (knowledge-graph memory), sequential-thinking (step-by-step reasoning). Needs Node.js (npx) and uv on this machine. Once enabled every employee can use them; toggle each one below.
